title: Ads-Txt-Auditor Input
description: Raw string contents of an ads.txt file to be audited against IAB ads.txt spec v1.1.

ads_txt_content.description: The full raw text of the ads.txt file. May include comment lines (starting with #), blank lines, variable declarations (SUBDOMAIN=, CONTACT=, INVENTORYPARTNERDOMAIN=), and data lines in the format: ad_system_domain, publisher_id, relationship[, certification_authority_id].

platform_domain.description: Optional. The domain of the platform (SSP/exchange) whose GAB entry should be verified. If omitted, the auditor will attempt contextual inference from the file contents.

examples.ads_txt_content:
google.com, pub-1234567890, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0
rubiconproject.com, 17960, RESELLER, 0bfd66d529a55807
